faq.q: What is the salary of a bank officer in Bangladesh?
faq.a: For private banks, Bangladesh Bank set a minimum in 2022: BDT 28,000 a month in probation and BDT 39,000 after confirmation for entry-level officers. Management trainee programmes pay more, roughly BDT 45,000-85,000. State-owned banks pay under the national pay scale. These are ranges, not promises.

faq.q: What qualification do I need for a bank job?
faq.a: A bachelor's degree at minimum. Most officer and MTO circulars ask for a four-year honours or a master's degree and set a minimum result, and they set an age limit. Any subject can apply for most general posts; read each circular.

State-owned banks and Bangladesh Bank recruit through the Bangladesh Bank e-recruitment site with a written test and viva. Private banks publish circulars on their career pages and run a written or computer-based test and one or more interviews.

faq.q: What is the difference between MTO and Officer?
faq.a: A Management Trainee Officer (MTO) is a fast-track entry with higher pay, tougher selection and rotation across departments. Trainee Assistant Officer, Assistant Officer and Officer are regular entry posts with a normal promotion ladder.

They are the two parts of the Banking Professional Exam run by the Institute of Bankers, Bangladesh, held twice a year. Bangladesh Bank links them to promotion, and the rule has changed several times, so check the current circular. Start JAIBB in your first year.

faq.q: Is banking a good career in Bangladesh in 2026?
faq.a: It still offers respect, structure and benefits, but choose the bank carefully. The sector's bad-loan ratio was about 33% in mid-2026, while more than 30 of 61 banks stayed in single digits. Check a bank's annual report and news before you join.

faq.q: What should a banker CV include?
faq.a: A short profile, your desk (general banking, credit, trade), numbers such as customers served, loan files processed and deposits brought, KYC/AML work, JAIBB/AIBB status and training. Keep it to two pages and follow the circular if it gives a format.

faq.q: What is a good career objective for a bank job?
faq.a: One or two lines with your strength and the post, for example: 'Business graduate with strong numeracy and communication skills seeking a Trainee Officer position to build a career in general banking and credit.'

body_md:
**By [Daloyar Hassan Shishir](https://www.dhshishir.com)** · Career consultant, founder of Career Solutions and HereWeGrow · Facts last checked: 12 November 2026

> **Quick answer:** A bank officer in Bangladesh serves customers, opens accounts, handles cash, remittance and loans, and keeps the bank within Bangladesh Bank rules. Bangladesh Bank's minimum for entry-level private bank officers is BDT 28,000 a month in probation and BDT 39,000 after confirmation. Management trainee programmes pay more. Promotion depends on performance and the JAIBB and AIBB exams.

## Bank officer career at a glance

| Question | Short answer |
|---|---|
| Who hires? | 61 scheduled banks: state-owned, private, Islamic and foreign, plus NBFIs |
| Entry posts | Trainee Assistant Officer, Assistant Officer, Officer, Probationary Officer, MTO |
| Minimum education | Graduate; most officer and MTO posts ask for a 4-year honours or master's with good results |
| How you are selected | Online application, written test (often MCQ + written), then viva |
| Minimum entry pay (private banks) | BDT 28,000 in probation, BDT 39,000 after confirmation |
| Professional exam | Banking Professional Exam: JAIBB then AIBB (Institute of Bankers, Bangladesh) |

## What does a bank officer do?

A bank officer is the person customers meet and the person the bank trusts with its money and records. The work depends on the desk:

- **General banking:** account opening and KYC, cheque books, cash, clearing, deposits (savings, current, DPS, FDR).
- **Credit:** collecting loan papers, checking CIB reports, analysing income, visiting the business, follow-up and recovery.
- **Foreign exchange and remittance:** inward remittance, LC documents, student files.
- **Cards, digital banking and agent banking:** customer support and sales.

**A normal day:** counters open in the morning, customer service and vouchers through the day, then balancing the cash and closing entries after the doors shut. Month end, quarter end and December closing are the busiest times.

> "Indeed, Allah commands you to render trusts to whom they are due." (meaning of Quran 4:58)

## Scope: where this career can take you

- **Branch banking:** officer to branch manager.
- **Credit and risk:** SME, retail, corporate credit, credit administration, recovery.
- **Trade finance and treasury:** LC, foreign exchange, money market.
- **Operations and compliance:** AML/CFT, internal control, audit.
- **Digital and technology:** cards, internet banking, MFS partnerships, data.
- **Islamic banking:** full Islamic banks, plus Islamic branches and windows of conventional banks.
- **Central bank:** Bangladesh Bank Assistant Director and officer posts.
- **Beyond banks:** NBFIs, microfinance, fintech, insurance, corporate finance and treasury teams.
- **Abroad:** Gulf exchange houses and banks, and Bangladeshi banks' foreign subsidiaries.

## Salary in Bangladesh (2026 ranges)

| Level | Typical post | Monthly pay (BDT) | Visual |
|---|---|---|---|
| Entry | Trainee / Assistant Officer, Officer | 28,000 - 45,000 | ███ |
| Entry (fast track) | Management Trainee Officer | 45,000 - 85,000 | ██████ |
| Mid | Senior / Principal Officer | 60,000 - 120,000 (estimate) | █████████ |
| Senior | Manager, AVP and above | 150,000 - 300,000+ (estimate) | ██████████████████ |

**How we got these ranges.**

- The floor is official: in January 2022 Bangladesh Bank fixed, for the first time, a minimum of BDT 28,000 for entry-level private bank officers in probation and BDT 39,000 after confirmation.
- Trainee programmes pay more. Published 2026 examples include a relationship officer programme at BDT 50,000 in training, and a management trainee programme advertised at BDT 83,000 a month.
- Mid and senior figures are our estimates from circulars and bankers' accounts; banks do not publish them. A Bangladesh Bank report to the High Court in 2022 said additional managing directors of private banks earned around BDT 600,000 a month on average.
- **State-owned banks** pay under the national pay scale with allowances. Always read the circular for the grade.

These are ranges, not promises.

### Who pays the most?

Foreign banks and the stronger private banks usually pay the most, especially through MTO programmes. State-owned banks pay less in cash at the start but offer pension, job security and house-loan facilities. Inside any bank, corporate credit, treasury and trade finance roles tend to be valued most.

## Benefits beyond salary

- Festival bonuses, and in profitable banks an incentive bonus.
- Provident fund and gratuity; pension in state-owned banks.
- Staff loans (house, car) at reduced rates in many banks after a service period.
- Structured training at the bank's training institute and at BIBM.
- Social respect and a nationwide branch network.

## An honest look at the sector in 2026

Choose your bank with care. Bangladesh Bank data showed the sector's non-performing loan (NPL) ratio at 32.78% in June 2026. The picture is uneven: more than 30 of the 61 banks kept NPLs in single digits, while others are in deep stress and some are being merged or restructured. Before you accept an offer, read the bank's latest annual report, its NPL ratio and recent news. A slightly lower salary at a healthy bank is usually the better career decision.

## Top employers: Bangladesh and the world

**World: largest banks by assets (S&P Global Market Intelligence, April 2026)**

| Rank | Bank | Note |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) | about USD 7.65 trillion in assets |
| 2-4 | Agricultural Bank of China, China Construction Bank, Bank of China | China's other three state-owned giants |
| Largest outside China | JPMorgan Chase (USA) | |
| Largest in Europe | BNP Paribas (France) | overtook HSBC in 2026 |

**Bangladesh (alphabetical within each group, not a ranking):**

- **State-owned commercial banks:** Agrani, BASIC, BDBL, Janata, Rupali, Sonali. Specialised: Bangladesh Krishi Bank, RAKUB, Probashi Kallyan Bank.
- **Private banks with well-known graduate programmes:** Bank Asia, BRAC Bank, City Bank, Dutch-Bangla Bank, Eastern Bank, Mutual Trust Bank, Prime Bank and others.
- **Islamic banks:** Islami Bank Bangladesh, Shahjalal Islami Bank and others. Islamic banks held about 19% of the system's deposits at the end of 2025.
- **Foreign banks:** HSBC, Standard Chartered and others.
- **The regulator:** Bangladesh Bank.

## Skills employers ask for

| Skill | Why it matters | Demand |
|---|---|---|
| Customer service and communication | Every desk faces customers | █████ |
| Accuracy with cash and numbers | Mistakes cost money and trust | █████ |
| KYC, AML/CFT awareness | Legal duty of every banker | █████ |
| MS Excel and core banking software | Daily reports and entries | ████ |
| Credit analysis basics (CIB, ratios) | Needed for promotion | ████ |
| Selling deposits, cards and loans | Targets are part of the job | ████ |
| Business English and Bangla writing | Letters, memos, customer notes | ███ |
| Trade finance basics (LC, remittance) | Specialist, well rewarded | ███ |

*Demand bars are our reading of bank circulars and bankers' accounts, not a statistical survey.*

## Free ways to build these skills

- **Regulations:** circulars and guidelines on [bb.org.bd](https://www.bb.org.bd).
- **Banking Professional Exam:** syllabus and reading materials from [IBB](https://www.ibb.org.bd).
- **Research and training notices:** [BIBM](https://www.bibm.org.bd).
- **Excel:** Microsoft's free training at [support.microsoft.com/excel](https://support.microsoft.com/excel).
- **Bank written test practice:** maths, English, general knowledge and computer basics from past question papers.

## Professional exams, prizes and scholarships

**JAIBB and AIBB.** The Institute of Bankers, Bangladesh holds the Banking Professional Exam twice a year in two parts: JAIBB (foundation) and AIBB (advanced). Bangladesh Bank has changed the promotion rule several times; under the latest directive reported, passing it is required for promotion to higher positions from 1 January 2026. Check the current Bangladesh Bank circular, and start JAIBB in your first year.

**Prizes:** top JAIBB and AIBB results win medals and cash prizes, including the Bangladesh Bank Gold Medal.

**Further study (check each official site):** MBA or MBM in banking; [Chevening](https://www.chevening.org); [Commonwealth Scholarships](https://cscuk.fcdo.gov.uk); [DAAD](https://www.daad.de/en/). Useful global certificates later in your career: CDCS (trade finance), CAMS (anti-money-laundering), FRM (risk), CFA (investment).

## Long-term career timeline

| Years | Typical title | What to master |
|---|---|---|
| 0-2 | Trainee / Assistant Officer / Officer | General banking, cash, KYC, customer service; start JAIBB |
| 3-5 | Senior Officer | Credit files, remittance, deposit targets; finish JAIBB, start AIBB |
| 6-10 | Principal Officer / Senior Principal Officer | A specialism (credit, trade, compliance); lead a desk |
| 10-15 | Branch Manager / AVP / VP | People, profit, risk and audit results |
| 15+ | SVP, Division Head, DMD and above | Strategy, governance, regulator relations |

*A typical path, not a guarantee. Titles differ from bank to bank.*

## Plan your own path (5-minute worksheet)

1. **My level now:** (student / fresher / ___ years)
2. **My target:** (state bank / private bank / Islamic bank / Bangladesh Bank / MTO)
3. **Written test gaps:** maths ___, English ___, general knowledge ___, computer ___
4. **Three banks I will research this month** (annual report, NPL, news): ___, ___, ___
5. **Weekly study hours and day:** ___ hours on ___

Then take the free skill test on this page.

## Career shifts: where bankers move

- **Branch → credit, trade finance or treasury** (specialist tracks).
- **Bank → NBFI, microfinance or fintech/MFS.**
- **Bank → corporate finance or treasury** in large companies.
- **Bank → compliance and AML roles**, including abroad.
- **Bank → teaching, training or consultancy.**

## Where will you find more peace of mind?

There is no survey to rank this, so take it as a general pattern. Deposit and sales targets are the most common source of pressure in private banks. Operations, compliance and back-office roles usually have steadier days than sales roles. State-owned banks tend to offer more security and less target pressure, with slower growth. Whatever you choose, three habits protect your peace: never sign what you have not checked, never bend KYC for a target, and balance your work before you leave.

## Faith and history: banking as a trust

**Trust (amanah).** The Quran commands believers to return trusts to their owners and to judge with justice ([4:58](https://quran.com/4/58)), and to record debts in writing ([2:282](https://quran.com/2/282)). A banker lives these verses daily: other people's savings are a trust.

**Hadith.** The Prophet (peace be upon him) named betraying a trust among the signs of a hypocrite (Sahih al-Bukhari 33; Sahih Muslim 59).

**Interest (riba).** The Quran forbids riba ([2:275-279](https://quran.com/2/275-279)). This is why Islamic banking exists, and why many Muslims prefer to work in Islamic banks or Islamic windows. Scholars differ on working in conventional banks; if this matters to you, ask a scholar you trust before you choose.

**History.** The Bayt al-Mal (public treasury) of the early caliphate kept public money under written accounts, and historians of finance describe early Muslim merchants using written payment orders and transfers (hawala) across long trade routes.

## Your contribution to the nation

Banks turn people's savings into loans for farmers, small businesses and factories, and bring remittance home safely. Bangladesh's biggest banking problem today is bad loans. That problem is solved one honest credit file at a time: an officer who checks documents properly, refuses pressure and follows up on recovery protects depositors and the whole economy.

## Your contribution to the world

Bangladeshi bankers handle trade documents for garment exports worth billions of dollars, serve migrant workers in many countries, and work in anti-money-laundering teams that keep the global system clean. Trade finance (CDCS) and AML (CAMS) skills are recognised worldwide.

## If you want to be an entrepreneur

- **Agent banking outlet** for a bank in your area (each bank sets its own conditions).
- **MFS and bill-payment service point** alongside another business.
- **Loan-file and business-plan support** for small businesses that struggle with bank paperwork.
- **Bank job coaching** once you have real experience.

Banking experience also makes you a better business owner: you learn how lenders think.

## Research opportunities

- Topics that matter now: loan recovery and NPLs, SME and agricultural credit, agent banking and financial inclusion, Islamic finance, digital banks and cyber risk.
- Where: BIBM research and seminars, Bangladesh Bank publications and working papers, university business faculties.

## Whom to follow and learn from

Follow institutions: [Bangladesh Bank](https://www.bb.org.bd), [IBB](https://www.ibb.org.bd), [BIBM](https://www.bibm.org.bd), and the career pages of the banks you want to join. Read one business newspaper's banking page every day; viva boards ask about current banking news.

## Where to find bank jobs

- **Bangladesh Bank e-recruitment** ([erecruitment.bb.org.bd](https://erecruitment.bb.org.bd)) for Bangladesh Bank and state-owned bank circulars.
- **Bank career pages** for private bank job circulars and MTO programmes.
- [BDJobs](https://www.bdjobs.com) (Bank/Non-Bank Fin. Institution category) and newspapers' weekly job pages.

## Bank job CV: what to write

Many state-bank applications use an online form, not your own CV, so follow the circular. Private banks and NBFIs do read your CV. A banker CV should show numbers:

| Weak line | Better line |
|---|---|
| Worked in loan section. | Processed 120+ SME and retail loan proposals with CIB checks. |
| Maintained good recovery. | Brought the classified loan ratio of my portfolio down with monthly client visits. |
| Did customer service. | Served 150+ customers a week and opened accounts with complete KYC. |

*Use only your real, provable figures.*

**Career objective for a bank job (samples):**

- *Fresher:* "Business graduate with strong numeracy and communication skills seeking a Trainee Officer position to build a career in general banking and credit."
- *Experienced:* "Banker with 4 years in general banking and SME credit, JAIBB passed, seeking a Senior Officer role in credit."

Build yours free with the HereWeGrow CV Builder and the Banker CV template.

## Common mistakes in bank job applications

- Missing the photo or signature size the online form requires.
- Applying without reading the age limit and result requirements.
- A CV full of duties and no numbers.
- Going to the viva without knowing the bank's basics: chairman, MD, number of branches, recent news.
- Claiming skills you cannot explain in the viva.

## Sources and method

Figures were checked on 12 November 2026. Salary ranges combine the Bangladesh Bank minimum, published trainee programme pay and our own estimates.

- The Daily Star: [Tk 39,000 salary for entry-level private bankers](https://www.thedailystar.net/business/economy/banks/news/tk-39000-salary-entry-level-private-bankers-2943901); [Professional exam and bankers' promotion](https://www.thedailystar.net/node/3801211)
- The Financial Express: [Salaries of private banks: BB reports to HC](https://today.thefinancialexpress.com.bd/print/huge-gap-between-low-high-level-officials-1646240902); [Banking sector special issue, 2026](https://thefinancialexpress.com.bd/special-issues/some-swim-in-excellence-others-sink-in-stress); [Islamic banks' financial health, 2025](https://today.thefinancialexpress.com.bd/print/islamic-banks-financial-health-deteriorates-in-2025-1781719284)
- UNB: [Banking diploma and promotion directive](https://unb.com.bd/category/Business/banking-diploma-holders-to-get-extra-marks-in-promotion-bb/152379)
- The Institute of Bankers, Bangladesh: [About IBB](https://www.ibb.org.bd/about)
- S&P Global Market Intelligence: [The world's largest banks by assets, 2026](https://www.spglobal.com/market-intelligence/en/news-insights/research/2026/04/the-worlds-largest-banks-by-assets-2026)
- Bonik Barta: [State-owned banks in Bangladesh](https://en.bonikbarta.com/business/FjZJkOfKjXdwgSd4/)
- Bank and trainee programme circulars read 12 November 2026

**How to cite this page:** Shishir, D. H. (2026). *Bank officer career in Bangladesh: salary, skills, scope and roadmap.* HereWeGrow Career Hub. https://herewegrow.pro/careers/bank-officer

*This guide gives general career information. It does not promise a job or salary, and it is not financial or religious legal advice.*

growth_plan.y1: Learn general banking on the desk: accounts, cash, clearing and KYC. Pass probation, serve customers well, and register for JAIBB. Read every Bangladesh Bank circular your branch receives.
growth_plan.y2: Finish JAIBB, ask for exposure to credit or remittance, bring in deposits and accounts against target, and keep an error-free record in audits.
growth_plan.y3: Choose a specialism (credit, trade finance, compliance or digital), start AIBB, take one internal training in that area, and prepare for the Senior Officer promotion.

goal_sheet: Month 1: Learn account types, KYC forms and cheque rules
Month 2: Master cash and clearing procedures with zero errors
Month 3: Register for JAIBB and plan two subjects
Month 4: Learn CIB report reading and a basic loan file
Month 5: Excel for branch reports (lookup, pivot)
Month 6: Review targets, audit findings and next exam with your manager

test.explain: Banks must identify and verify every customer.

test.q: Which body receives suspicious transaction reports from banks in Bangladesh?
test.explain: The Bangladesh Financial Intelligence Unit handles anti-money-laundering reports.

test.q: Which account type is mainly for businesses and has no limit on the number of transactions?
test.explain: Current accounts are for frequent business transactions.

options: Money kept for a fixed term at an agreed rate
test.explain: The customer deposits a sum for a set period and earns an agreed return.
Real Time Gross Settlement moves large payments between banks instantly.

test.q: What is the CIB in Bangladesh?
test.explain: Banks check a borrower's CIB report before lending.

test.q: A non-performing loan (NPL) is a loan that:
options: Is not being repaid as agreed
test.explain: When repayments stop for the set period, the loan is classified.

options: An asset pledged as security for a loan
test.explain: If the borrower fails to pay, the bank can recover from the collateral.

test.q: CRR is the share of deposits a bank must keep:
test.explain: The Cash Reserve Ratio is held with the central bank.

options: A bank's undertaking to pay the seller when documents comply
test.explain: It gives the exporter payment security in trade.

test.q: A customer is angry about a delayed remittance. What do you do first?
options: Argue that it is not your fault
Listen, apologise for the trouble and check the status
test.explain: Calm listening and a quick status check solve most complaints.

test.q: Your manager asks you to open an account without the customer's ID to meet a target. You should:
options: Decline politely and explain that KYC documents are required
test.explain: KYC is a legal duty; targets never override it.

cover_letter_md:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I am applying for the post of [post name] advertised on [site/date]. I hold a [degree] from [university] and have [X years / an internship] in [general banking / credit / customer service]. In my last role I [one provable result with a number].

I am careful with numbers, comfortable with customers and ready to work anywhere in Bangladesh. My CV is attached.

Sincerely,
[Your name] | [Phone] | [Email]
interview_qs: Tell me about yourself. (Tip: 45 seconds: education, one strength, one result, why banking.)
Why do you want to be a banker? (Tip: Link your skills to service, numbers and trust; avoid 'for the salary'.)
Why this bank? (Tip: Know its chairman, MD, branches, main products and one recent news item.)
What is the difference between a savings and a current account? (Tip: Purpose, interest and transaction limits.)
What is KYC and why is it important? (Tip: Identify the customer, prevent money laundering, legal duty.)
What do you know about CRR and SLR? (Tip: Reserves banks keep; say you would confirm the current rates from Bangladesh Bank.)
What is an NPL and why is it a problem for Bangladesh? (Tip: Define it, mention the 2026 situation, and say recovery and careful lending matter.)
Your subject is not business. Why should we hire you? (Tip: Show numeracy, learning speed and customer skills with an example.)
How would you handle an angry customer? (Tip: Listen, apologise, solve or escalate, follow up.)
Can you meet deposit targets? (Tip: Give a realistic plan: your network, service quality, follow-up.)
Are you willing to work outside Dhaka? (Tip: Say yes clearly if you applied; banks post anywhere.)
What are your plans for JAIBB? (Tip: Give a timeline, starting in year one.)
What is your expected salary? (Tip: Refer to the bank's scale for the post.)
Tell us one current issue in the banking sector. (Tip: Read banking news the week before the viva.)
Do you have any questions for us? (Tip: Ask about training and the first posting.)
